description: Source code implementing Bluetooth TMAP (Telephony and Media Audio Profile) functionalities, including service registration, discovery, and characteristic read handling.

methods.name: tmap_char_read
methods.description: Handles reading the TMAP characteristic, processes the peer role, and calls the callback with the result.

methods.name: discover_func
methods.description: Callback for GATT discovery, identifies TMAS and TMAPR characteristics, initiates read of TMAP role.

methods.name: read_role
methods.description: Reads the TMAP role characteristic value.

methods.name: bt_tmap_register
methods.description: Registers the TMAP service with a specified role.

methods.name: bt_tmap_discover
methods.description: Starts discovery of TMAP service and characteristics on a Bluetooth connection.
